name: uberasm-sprite-shooting-ability-for-mario
title: Sprite Shooting Ability for Mario
description:
Allows you to shoot normal or custom sprites by pressing a button. This one allows you to limit how many sprites can be spawned, and adds an option to despawn any sprite spawned by this method*. Inspired by wiiq's attempt; this uses none of his code though.

* Uses $1FD6,x to determine this. If you have any sprites which modify this table it may break.
